links.outcome: Diagnostic accuracy of on-site xFFR versus off-site FFRct against invasive FFR on the same patients
links.effect: xFFR AUC 0.91 vs FFRct AUC 0.89 (P = 0.274); superior only for LAD (AUC 0.96 vs 0.84, P = 0.001).
links.quote: The overall diagnostic accuracy was comparable to FFRct (AUC: 0.91 vs AUC: 0.89; P = 0.274), superior only for left anterior descending coronary artery assessment (AUC: 0.96 vs AUC: 0.84; P = 0.001).

screen.reason: Prospective comparative study evaluating the diagnostic performance of an on-site deep learning CT-FFR algorithm compared to off-site FFRct and invasive FFR; evaluates clinical accuracy but does not test a specific organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
